svg.title: Evolutionary genomics and surveillance atlas (synthetic)
svg.desc: A karyon sheet of 8 panels in 2 columns: panel A, Orthogonal branches preserve row alignment and make terminal comparison fastest.; panel B, Diagonal edges emphasise topology while retaining branch length and exact annotations.; panel C, Curves carry posterior ancestral states, inferred transitions, mutation lists and concordance intervals.; panel D, Circular selection combines mean omega, fitted rate mixtures, recurrence and terminal metadata rings.; panel E, The same direct branch evidence survives a topology-balanced unrooted projection.; panel F, A tanglegram exposes core-versus-accessory discordance as crossings without altering either tree.; panel G, Protein architecture, selected codons and observed variants meet on one genomic coordinate axis.; panel H, A coalescent trajectory, lineage composition and growth alerts share the same time pivots..

svg.text: Orthogonal branches preserve row alignment and make terminal comparison fastest.
Diagonal edges emphasise topology while retaining branch length and exact annotations.
Curves carry posterior ancestral states, inferred transitions, mutation lists and concordance intervals.
Circular selection combines mean omega, fitted rate mixtures, recurrence and terminal metadata rings.
The same direct branch evidence survives a topology-balanced unrooted projection.
A tanglegram exposes core-versus-accessory discordance as crossings without altering either tree.
Protein architecture, selected codons and observed variants meet on one genomic coordinate axis.
A coalescent trajectory, lineage composition and growth alerts share the same time pivots.
